Hi, I’m Sean.

I build Tableau Prep, a data prep tool, at Tableau. I’m a compassionate problem solver focused on making data more useful and collaborative.

I’m not all work, though. You’ll find me riding public transit for fun, chasing snow on skis, poking at new technologies, and building mobile games like TuBu. Lately I’ve been writing down the things I notice along the way.
